scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter api lint
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api start:dev" "pnpm --filter desktop dev:electron"
scripts.build:desktop: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3457/api NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter desktop build
scripts.build:desktop:mac: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3457/api NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter desktop build:mac
scripts.build:desktop:win: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3457/api NODE_ENV=production TARGET_PLATFORM=win32 TARGET_ARCH=x64 pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter desktop build:win
scripts.build:desktop:linux: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3457/api NODE_ENV=production TARGET_PLATFORM=linux TARGET_ARCH=x64 pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter desktop build:linux
